conservation.technical_description: The object is executed on paper, mounted to a secondary support, which is visible at the edges of the sheet. The edges of the primary support show signs of wear overall, most notably at the corners. The lower left sheet corner is lifting from the secondary support, and the lower right sheet corner is creased. A 7-inch diagonal crease runs down the red field from the left side of the sheet to the center. There is a ¾ inch abrasion in the blue field on the bottom left, 1 ½ inches up from the bottom and 1 inch from the lect. The lower right quadrant shows general signs of slight soiling. There is mechanical cracking in all areas of heavier impasto, all of which appear to be stable at this time. The extreme left and right edges of the sheet are lifting slightly from bowing and should be monitored. There are two small, dark specks in the upper and lower right quadrants of the sheet, and there is what appears to be a small natural inclusion in the lower left quadrant near the edge of the sheet. There is a brush fiber embedded in the upper left quadrant in the red field, near the left edge of the sheet.

materials.content: Watercolor on moderately thick, cream, smooth wove paper with a slightly fuzzy feel*
